🎬 Hidden Figures (2016)

Hidden Figures tells the inspiring true story of three brilliant African American women whose extraordinary contributions helped shape NASA’s early space missions during the 1960s. Working at the Langley Research Center in Virginia, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan, and Mary Jackson face racial segregation, gender discrimination, and limited opportunities despite their exceptional intelligence and dedication. Katherine, a gifted mathematician, earns a position calculating critical flight trajectories for America’s space program, where her accuracy becomes essential to the success of astronaut John Glenn’s historic orbital mission. Meanwhile, Dorothy recognizes the growing importance of electronic computers and works tirelessly to develop programming skills while fighting for recognition and leadership opportunities. Mary pursues her dream of becoming an engineer, challenging discriminatory educational barriers that threaten to prevent her advancement. As the United States competes with the Soviet Union in the Space Race, the three women must prove their abilities in a workplace that frequently overlooks their achievements. Through determination, friendship, courage, and groundbreaking scientific work, they challenge expectations and help make history. Combining powerful performances, emotional storytelling, historical significance, and uplifting moments, the film celebrates perseverance, equality, education, friendship, and the remarkable individuals whose contributions helped humanity reach beyond Earth.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • History

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 7m • PG

🎥 Director: Theodore Melfi
